title: “In 2022, one of Peter Thiel’s favorite thinkers envisioned a second Trump...
content: “In 2022, one of Peter Thiel’s favorite thinkers envisioned a second Trump Administration in which the federal government would be run by a “CEO” who was not Trump and laid out a playbook for how it might work. Elon Musk is following it.”
author: Jason Kottke
